assumptions.choice: Treat only momentum exactly equal to zero as close to zero.
assumptions.reason: The specification supplies no numerical tolerance.

assumptions.choice: Use current total broker portfolio value as capital and permit fractional share sizes so notional exposure equals min(w, 10%) of capital at the observed close.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define capital or require whole-share rounding.

assumptions.choice: Treat the first next() call made after Backtrader indicator warm-up as a rebalancing date, followed by every R strategy bars.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives a frequency but no calendar anchor.

assumptions.choice: When already positioned, submit the required close first and, after it completes, submit the entry selected from the signal and liquidity values on the rebalancing date.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader orders execute asynchronously, and the specification requires every existing position to be closed at rebalancing before opening the re-evaluated position.
